metadata.title: That 1 kill where I wasn’t even sure if I was shooting or daydreaming LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just stumble into that kill?
My brain was offline but the bullet wasn’t.
Click if your aim’s mostly chaos but somehow pays off!
Valorant logic = peak comedy.

Tap if your best kills come from pure confusion!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
